title: Saturn Industries
description: saturnind.com zoominfo.com/c/saturn-industries-ltd/348367401 Saturn Industries, based in Winnipeg, Manitoba, is a specialized manufacturer of custom-engineered trailers and overhead lifting products. Operating as a division of BROCK LEMKO Inc., the company serves demanding sectors such as construction, marine, powerline, mining, and aerospace. Since 1996, they have built a strong reputation for designing and fabricating tailored solutions, including dump trailers, lifting beams, and personnel baskets. Their focus remains on durability, safety, and delivering highly customized industrial equipment to meet specific client applications
